name: Fluid Pump (Manual)
description: Hold [$[action_interact_left]]/[$[action_interact_right]] to create pressure in the pump. Connect to an inlet and outlet to create a pumping system to move fluid around a vehicle.
shortDescription: A small fluid pump with a manual handle.

logicNodes.label: Fluid In
logicNodes.description: Connect to an inlet component to take fluid into the system.

logicNodes.label: Fluid Out
logicNodes.description: Connect to an outlet component to release fluid from the system.
